title: 2025 National Bridge Inventory, New Jersey highway bridges, comma-delimited
horizontal_datum_note: Items 16 and 17 are latitude and longitude packed as degrees, minutes, seconds, and hundredths of a second. The SNBI commentary for B.L.05 and B.L.06 says those coordinates are consistent with a linear referencing system on the North American Datum of 1983. Longitude is stored without a west sign.
vertical_datum_note: The 123-column file has no deck-elevation column and no vertical datum. Structure length, maximum span, deck width, and clearances are metres. Item 58 deck condition is a rating code, not an elevation.

units.deck_condition_item_58: rating code 0-9 or N, not an elevation
